name: startlux-27b-jeval-20261019
description: StartLux-Decision 27B AutoThink on JEVal (11,257 items, all prompt lengths; longest single prompt 82,749 tokens). Served with --max-model-len 98304 so the 54.7 GB BF16 weights leave room for KV cache and the activation peak on an 80 GB H100; the longest prompt still fits whole, with ~15K tokens of thought room. One vLLM 0.19.1 server per GPU (8 replicas), official startlux-decide serve --launch-vllm path, gpu-memory-utilization 0.95. Requires the 27B weights pre-downloaded to models/StartLux-27B-AutoThink on shared storage; compute nodes have no network. Writes predictions, answers, metrics, nvidia-smi samples and the score summary under logs/qz/startlux_27b/. Resumable. If startup OOMs, lower MAX_MODEL_LEN to 86016 or use direct mode with --tp-size 2.
command: mkdir -p /inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/logs/qz && cd /inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare && HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True CONCURRENCY=256 MAX_MODEL_LEN=98304 bash scripts/qz/run_startlux_jeval.sh 27b 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 > /inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/logs/qz/startlux-27b-jeval.log 2>&1
